Persistent card/player links are undirected unique pairs with request-derived IDs; repeated Link is a no-op. Explicit link removal changes no card data. Kind/existence/self-link applicability, exact relevant replay/inverse, preservation of unrelated edits and missing-endpoint inverse failure are checked.

Captured selected/unselected menu targets survive selection changes, reordered views and sync edits. Native controller emits individual operations, skips real-card removal and vanished captured targets, fans selection to card/player endpoints, consumes picking taps and prevents dispatch across play incarnation changes.

Native catalog search includes Blank, filters invalid/non-token records and retains distinct exact printing identities. Covered endpoint labels do not leak names; Connections membership is identity-based, not same-name/definition/source highlighting. Queue rejection retains input rather than pretending to edit shared state.
